_instructions: This file maps every movable tile type to a closeup photo you provide.
HOW TO ADD YOUR TILE PHOTOS:
1. Take a closeup photo of each tile (any angle, any lighting).
2. Name the file exactly as shown in the 'image' field below.
3. Place all photos in the folder:  public/tile-templates/
(create the folder if it doesn't exist)
4. Save this file — the app picks up changes on next reload.
PHOTO TIPS:
- Frame the tile so it fills most of the photo (no need to crop precisely).
- The app crops the center 60% of each photo for matching, so a little
wall/border around the edges is fine.
- One photo per tile type is enough. Rotation doesn't matter.
- Any common format works: JPG, PNG, HEIC, WEBP.
- Blank tile photos are just as important as treasure photos — they give
the matcher a positive 'this is empty' reference rather than relying on
'nothing matched well enough'. One blank photo per shape is sufficient.
FIELDS:
treasure_id : treasure ID string, or '__blank__' for a blank tile
image       : filename inside public/tile-templates/ (include extension)
shape       : 'corner' | 'straight' | 't-junction'
note        : free-text reminder, not used by the app
enabled     : set to false to skip this tile during matching
TREASURE IDs (movable tiles only):
Corner-shaped  : lizard, moth, owl, scarab, rat, spider
T-junction     : bat, dragon, ghost_bottle, ghost_waving, lady_pig, sorceress
Blank          : use '__blank__' for shape corner, straight, or t-junction
